annotations.title: Fire weather risk & red-flag check (US, NWS)

description: Fire weather risk & red-flag check (US, NWS) — Wildfire weather risk for any US point for the next 12-156 hours (hours=, default 72): hourly Fosberg Fire Weather Index from National Weather Service temperature, humidity and wind, red-flag-like hours (RH 15% or less with strong wind), hot-dry-windy hours, mixing height, daily summaries, plus any active Red Flag Warning / Fire Weather Watch for the point. Verdict RED FLAG / CRITICAL / WATCH / ELEVATED / LOW. lat/lon or place. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).

place.description: or a place name, e.g. Boulder, CO

name: weather_fire_weather
